title: Overly broad file permissions (c) — review required
description: Code in c grants world-writable or world-readable permissions: fd = open(p, O_CREAT, 0777). Any local user can then modify or read the file. This lexical rule flags the grant; the reviewer confirms the breadth is intended or tightens it.
remediation: Grant the narrowest workable mode (0644/0755 least privilege) and rely on group ownership instead of world bits.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the mode regardless of file sensitivity.
